scope: Pre-Q3-release entry only; not a current full-company valuation or a permanent prohibition
reason: A known earnings event and improving guided income do not establish a same-basis expectations mismatch, persistent incremental earnings or a defensible entry ceiling. Manual delayed action can miss repricing and cannot bound an overnight gap.
independent_review: Pending; subsequent findings are separate dated records and do not rewrite this disposition
reopen_only_with: New reconciled forward income, expense and credit evidence versus adequately defined expectations
Financial resilience, capital and ownership updated consistently for the prospective holding window
Separately supported value/price response and fresh executable price, FX and costs
An opportunity that still exists after hours or days of human response delay
evaluation: Retain this rejected candidate when reviewing the event outcome. A later rise would not retrospectively create an executable, evidenced entry. A later fall would not prove all rejection reasoning correct.
paper_cohort: No accepted-entry cohort opened: investable passive benchmark and complete paired exit rules are not selected. No dummy benchmark, quote or fill supplied to satisfy a schema.
portfolio_boundary: User-owned isolated sleeve; no unrelated ISA holdings, extra contributions, broker connection or order automation
